### Submission checklist

- [x] This is a bug, not a usage question.
- [x] I added a clear and descriptive title.
- [x] I searched existing issues and didn't find this.
- [x] I can reproduce this with the latest released version.
- [x] I included a minimal reproducible example and steps to reproduce.

### Area (Required)

- [x] deepagents (SDK)
- [ ] dcode
- [ ] talon
- [ ] acp
- [ ] evals
- [ ] daytona
- [ ] modal
- [ ] quickjs
- [ ] runloop
- [ ] vercel
- [ ] langsmith-sandbox
- [ ] Other / not sure / general

### Related Issues / PRs

#6852 reported this same bug but was automatically closed because it was submitted programmatically. I am resubmitting through the official web form as instructed.

#6851 contains the proposed fix and regression tests. It remains closed pending maintainer assignment.

#1488 introduced concurrent summary generation and history offloading.

### Reproduction Steps / Example Code (Python)

```python
git clone https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents.git
cd deepagents
git checkout caaa7e7c12d214afa5cf0a1afed8eb6232aa6f7b
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LucasGois1/deepagents/8789ee38df2474ba8c33695bbad846e2711bbc43/libs/deepagents/tests/unit_tests/middleware/test_summarization_lifecycle.py -o libs/deepagents/tests/unit_tests/middleware/test_summarization_lifecycle.py
cd libs/deepagents
uv sync --frozen --group test --python 3.14.7
make test TEST_FILE=tests/unit_tests/middleware/test_summarization_lifecycle.py PYTEST_EXTRA='-n 0 --timeout=30' COV_ARGS=''
```

### Error Message and Stack Trace (if applicable)

```shell
AssertionError: public invocation released its owner while history remained admitted
AssertionError: cancellation released the public invocation before admitted I/O settled

5 failed, 2 passed
```

### Description

When summary generation fails while an admitted history write is still running, the public create_deep_agent invocation can raise before that write settles. A caller may consequently close its backend while the write remains active.

I expect the invocation to wait for its admitted history operation to settle before propagating the summary exception or caller cancellation.

The reproducer exercises the real public graph with a controlled model and a real FilesystemBackend. An Event holds the history write while the native summary retries fail. Repeated cancellation after summary failure also releases the invocation before settlement. No credentials or remote services are required.

The unpatched official source produces five failures and two passes. The proposed patch in #6851 keeps the operations concurrent and joins their outcomes before propagating failure or cancellation. Ordinary archive failures remain nonfatal. The patched summarization/lifecycle suite produced 90 passes, with Ruff, formatting and ty checks passing locally.

Could a maintainer confirm the intended lifetime contract and assign LucasGois1 if the approach is appropriate? The existing PR #6851 can be reused.

### Environment / System Info

OS: macOS
Python: 3.14.7
deepagents: 0.7.23
langchain: 1.4.3
langchain-core: 1.6.7
Official source commit: caaa7e7c12d214afa5cf0a1afed8eb6232aa6f7b
Dependencies: frozen official package lockfile

Also reproduced on official 0.7.22 source. The published 0.7.23 wheel's summarization source is byte-identical to the tested official source.

No credentials or special environment variables are required.

For reference, the narrow approach I'd take is the same shape the issue describes: keep summary generation and `awrite` offload concurrent, join both outcomes before the public invocation exits, re-raise the original summary exception (or the cancellation) only after the admitted write settles, and keep ordinary archive failures nonfatal. No public API changes, with regression tests using a controlled model and a local `FilesystemBackend`.

Preferred path: assign LucasGois1 and reopen #6851. If you'd rather I take it (or help with review or extra test cases), please say so and assign me. I won't open a PR unless you confirm. (This comment was drafted with AI assistance and reviewed by me.)

Rechecked on the latest SDK release, **0.7.30** (`42adc1bca1147715ac58fad49bc74c12fa63bb84`), and current `main` (`c89da392fbfdea1df7b6ff1ea8bad030efab090d`), using each package's frozen lockfile and Python 3.14.7. A narrow four-case public-graph reproduction still gives **2 failed, 2 passed**: summary error / `GraphDrained` return while the admitted write is unfinished; successful summary and ordinary archive-failure controls pass.

Reproduce without copying any SDK fix:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents.git
cd deepagents
git checkout 42adc1bca1147715ac58fad49bc74c12fa63bb84
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LucasGois1/deepagents/76b5efa958e14b1b7b4904ba0fc60af0342db604/libs/deepagents/tests/unit_tests/middleware/test_summarization_lifecycle.py -o libs/deepagents/tests/unit_tests/middleware/test_summarization_lifecycle.py

make test TEST_FILE=tests/unit_tests/middleware/test_summarization_lifecycle.py PYTEST_EXTRA='-n 0 --timeout=30' COV_ARGS=''
```

The failing assertion is `backend.finished.is_set()` after `ainvoke` has already raised the original exception. These tests use a controlled model and real local `FilesystemBackend`; no credentials or remote service are required. They specifically cover admitted writes on summary failure, not external task cancellation or process loss.

The existing #6851 can be reused if a maintainer approves the lifetime contract and assigns the issue. I have kept it closed and have not submitted a duplicate fix PR while assignment is pending.
